==Transportation==
*[[Senntisten Teleport]] and run north-west.
*[[Chronicle]] teleport and run east.
*[[Digsite teleport]] or [[Digsite pendant]] and run south-west.
*[[Varrock Teleport]] and run out the southern gates then east.
